turns.text: Hey there! Great questions! When it comes to making pizza healthier, it's more about choosing toppings that are high in nutrients like fiber, vitamins, and minerals. Pineapple can be a good choice because it’s rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. Butter isn’t necessary for health; olive oil could be a better option if you’re looking to add some flavor without extra calories. Ham is fine in moderation but might be higher in sodium. Focus on veggies, lean proteins, and whole grains for a balanced pizza!
